description: MainActivity.java - Android Java source file implementing the main screen of a notes app, handling UI initialization, note list display, search, navigation drawer, and user interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for displaying and managing list of notes, including search, navigation, and note interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up navigation drawer, load notes, and attaches event listeners.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles tap event on a note to open it for editing.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long press event to delete a note.

methods.name: reloadNotes
methods.description: Refreshes the displayed list of notes based on current search query and filters.

methods.name: onNavigationItemSelected
methods.description: Handles navigation menu selections for filtering notes.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Closes navigation drawer if open, otherwise exits activity.
